tool_args.rationale: Five observations at fixed x_now, mem_conv, near-constant s_grad, and fixed H establish a monotone-concave response but do not identify how it changes on an unobserved input branch. The inexpensive open-branch probe can distinguish the candidate response families before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Haldane substrate-inhibition model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations are monotone-concave over the sampled u_now range, so the inhibitory high-u downturn is unsupported; the untested branch remains ambiguous.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Cobb-Douglas power law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies in the five rows, leaving the effect of s_grad unidentifiable and making it difficult to distinguish a power law from a saturating response.
A discriminating input outside the existing narrow branch is more valuable than refining the same u_now-only trajectory.
It is irrelevant to the candidate mechanisms and explicitly not worth purchasing.
